answer: Use a long-delay payout ledger. Each agent identity earns into an escrow that releases only after a 90-day horizon of verified tasks. Because payouts stay locked, a sybil farmer must fund compute and monitoring for every clone across that ocean of time before recovering anything. Any identity caught routing rewards through a shared inlet—common wallets or task brokers—forfeits escrow and pays a 50-credit audit charge per clone.
